honing_confound: Death Strike identity amplifies the Fenrir's Messenger arrow's damage — this single skill's damage scales heavily with Magic power (gear honing). Tier standing reflects the peak damage of this skill at T4 ceiling.

delivery.evidence: Sharpshooter is a long-range archer class. All skills fire arrows at target location. Primary skills: Fenrir's Messenger (tracking arrow), Arrow Rain (AoE arrow shower), Arrow Nova (rapid arrow burst), Sharp Shooter (charged arrow shot).

footprint.evidence: Arrow Rain creates an AoE shower at target location (multi-arrow zone). Arrow Nova fires multiple arrows. Fenrir's Messenger is single-target tracking arrow. Mix of point and zone footprints.

geo_text: Long-range pure archer class. Death Strike Sharpshooter manages Arrow Spirit buff stacks (from Arrow Spirit skill) to amplify Ghost Arrow (Z identity skill) and Fenrir's Messenger damage. The identity is managing two systems: Arrow Spirit buff uptime for skill amplification, and the Ghost Arrow identity skill for burst windows.

control.evidence: Some archer skills have knockback on impact. No CC identity.

defense.evidence: Archer class — low armor (leather), high mobility. Dodge via repositioning dashes. Sharpshooter is one of the most mobile Gunners.

economy.resource_verbatim: Arrow Spirit Buff (stacks) + Arrow Gauge (Identity Meter)
economy.builder_source: Arrow Spirit skill (identity-generating ability) builds both Arrow Spirit stacks and Arrow Gauge. Other skills generate Arrow Gauge passively.
economy.plain_text: TWO-LAYER ECONOMY: (1) Arrow Spirit buff: builds up via Arrow Spirit skill, providing damage amplification stacks for marked skills. (2) Arrow Gauge (Identity Meter): fills via skills → enables Ghost Arrow (Z) and Fenrir's Messenger use. DEATH STRIKE IDENTITY: enhances the final shot's damage — specifically the charged big-arrow hit. Strategy: maintain Arrow Spirit buff → use big damage skills within buff window → activate identity skills for burst.

element.evidence: Arrow-based attacks deal Physical damage. Some skills may have elemental arrow types — not confirmed from live sources.

movement.evidence: High mobility for a ranged class. Cloaking abilities and repositioning dashes available. Long-range engagement means movement is used to maintain safe distance rather than close range.

attr.evidence: Long-range archer — attacks from maximum safe distance. Primary engagement at 20-30m range.

range.evidence: Sharpshooter has among the longest attack ranges in LA. Arrow Rain covers a large area at distance.

tempo.evidence: Death Strike centers on buff-window burst: Arrow Spirit buff → big arrow damage in window → Ghost Arrow identity. Between windows: generate Arrow Gauge and Arrow Spirit.

amp.value: Arrow Spirit buff: amplifies marked skill damage; Death Strike: enhances charged big-arrow hit specifically
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Specific multipliers not confirmed from live sources in this session.

proxy.evidence: No proxy mechanics (Loyal Companion would have hawk proxy; Death Strike does not).

commitment.evidence: Charged arrow skills (Sharp Shooter, Fenrir's Messenger) require charge time. Arrow Rain is a cast-and-place. Mix of channel and wind-up.

mechanics_notes: 1) Sharpshooter has a STEALTH skill (Camouflage) — unique in LA's ranged assassin space but on a traditional archer class. This creates a brief repositioning window while invisible. No engine equivalent. 2) Death Strike vs Loyal Companion is the Sharpshooter's 'self-DPS vs summon-supported DPS' fork — Death Strike is pure personal output optimization; Loyal Companion adds a hawk companion that provides combat assistance. 3) Arrow Spirit buff uptime management is the skill expression for Death Strike — a buff that must be refreshed while executing the main rotation. This dual-track management (buff maintenance + damage rotation) is the identity challenge.
stabilization_patch: Death Strike has been the preferred Sharpshooter identity in most patches for single-target boss damage. Loyal Companion favored for mobility-heavy content.
tier_standing_release: B/C-tier at launch (Sharpshooter generally lower tier overall)
tier_standing_current: C-tier (community tier lists 2025-2026; Sharpshooter is one of the least-played classes). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Fenrir's Messenger damage ceiling at T4 is competitive but difficulty of consistent Arrow Spirit uptime limits practical output.

honing_confound: Hawk (Silverhawk) damage scales with Specialization stat (gear-honing indexed). Companion damage contribution compounds with personal arrow damage at high honing.

delivery.evidence: Loyal Companion adds Silverhawk (hawk companion) as a persistent proxy. Hawk performs talon strikes and slash attacks on marked targets. Personal arrow delivery is the same as Death Strike.

footprint.evidence: Hawk acts at target location; arrows come from caster. Two simultaneous damage sources at potentially different positions.

geo_text: Loyal Companion Sharpshooter deploys Silverhawk (Z identity activation) as a hawk companion that continuously attacks targets alongside the Sharpshooter's arrows. The hawk follows the caster, can be re-targeted, and provides independent damage. Identity is about maintaining hawk deployment and synergizing hawk attacks with personal skill rotation.

economy.resource_verbatim: Arrow Gauge (Identity Meter) — deploys Silverhawk on full
economy.builder_source: Skills fill Arrow Gauge. Silverhawk deploys when Arrow Gauge is used and persists until dismissed or time expires.
economy.plain_text: HAWK DEPLOYMENT ECONOMY: Arrow Gauge fills via skills → activate Silverhawk (hawk companion deploys). Hawk performs independent attacks on marked targets. LOYAL COMPANION IDENTITY: enhances Silverhawk's damage output, extends hawk duration, amplifies Hawk skill synergies. The economy is DEPLOY → MAINTAIN HAWK UPTIME → REDEPLOY as needed. Dual damage source reduces dependence on self-managed Arrow Spirit uptime vs Death Strike.

element.evidence: Same Physical damage. Hawk talon attacks also Physical.

movement.evidence: Same mobility profile. Hawk follows caster — can reposition freely while hawk maintains target engagement.

range.evidence: Personal attacks at 20-30m. Hawk acts at target location regardless of caster distance.

tempo.evidence: Loyal Companion is more sustained than Death Strike: hawk provides continuous damage output between skill cooldowns. Less burst-window dependent.

amp.value: Silverhawk continuous damage (Loyal Companion amplified); hawk skill synergies
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Loyal Companion identity specifically enhances hawk damage — exact multipliers not confirmed from live sources.

proxy.evidence: Silverhawk IS a proxy entity — an autonomous companion that deals independent damage. PROXY DELIVERY for Loyal Companion Sharpshooter.

commitment.evidence: Same personal skill commitment. Hawk acts independently so no added commitment for hawk damage.

mechanics_notes: 1) Loyal Companion makes Sharpshooter one of two gunner classes with a proxy entity (alongside Artillerist turrets in certain builds). The hawk is a pet/companion proxy, not a temporary summon — it persists while deployed. 2) MOBILITY ADVANTAGE: the hawk continues attacking while the Sharpshooter repositions. This makes Loyal Companion better than Death Strike for mobility-heavy raid content (can move without losing DPS). 3) The hawk + caster dual-output is visually dramatic — the Sharpshooter shoots while a silver hawk attacks in parallel. This is the class's signature aesthetic. 4) CORPUS NOTE: Loyal Companion Sharpshooter and Communication Overflow Summoner are the two clearest 'companion DPS' archetypes in LA — both use autonomous AI companions as primary damage contributors.
stabilization_patch: Loyal Companion initially preferred for mobile raid content; Death Strike favored for stationary boss windows.
tier_standing_current: C-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: hawk damage scaling with Specialization means honing significantly amplifies companion output at T4.
